description: Tomba! is a platform/adventure/puzzle game for the PSX

v0.0.1-alpha.description:
This is the initial **alpha release** introducing multiworld randomizer functionality for *Tomba!* via the Archipelago framework. 

> [!WARNING]
> This release is in an early testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🗺️ World, Progression & Logic Coverage
* **Complete Mapping**: All base game **events**, **items**, and **regions** are fully covered and integrated into the randomizer logic.
* **Archipelago Integration**: Clearing events and getting items serves as location checks to send and receive items across the multiworld.

### 🛠️ Stability & Softlock Fixes
* **Logic Safeguards**: Some events have been patched to make sure you can no longer soft-lock them:
    * **Where the Barrel Rolls**: The Barrel respawns if you break it
    * **Take Out**: This event is automaticaly cleared if you cleared "Hide and Go Seek" (and the reward is dispatched as location check)
    * **Biting Plant Flower**: In the first area after the fog, the blue apple that allows to get that flower early is also respawned upon leaving the area until you hit it and grab the flower
    * **Chests**: Some chests with multiple items are also respawned until both items are acquired correctly
* **Known Exception**: The **"I'm so Hungry"** event is currently excluded from these fixes and can still cause a softlock. Use caution when managing food-related progression.

### ⚙️ New Slot Options
You can now configure these new settings in your player YAML:
* `bell_warp`: Allows the Bell to be randomized. Be wary that those can potentialy lead to issues as the event logic is not fool proof yet.
* `keep_blackjack`: Choose whether to keep Tomba's Blackjack weapon from the beginning or randomize it into the item pool.

### 🚫 Non-Randomized Elements
To preserve game stability, the following elements remain in their vanilla states and are **not randomized**:
* The **Furious Tornado** on the mailbox.
* The **Frog** required for the *Take Me Home* event.

---

## 🔧 Installation
1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file.
2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.

v0.0.2-alpha.description:
Second **alpha release** introducing various bug fixes and improvements regarding Archipelago synchronization.

> [!WARNING]
> This release is in an early testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🛠️ Stability & Softlock Fixes
* Rewrote the game interface assembly in order to pop found items from the game only when they have successfully been processed
* Added some more info in the README section
* Fix #6 : Added Section information on Leaf Butterflies and changed numerotation
* Fix #10 : Added a threshold so location that are too far are not checked
* Fixed the Pipe location: The actual item is not required by the game logic so the location can stay without creating a softlock in Baccus Lake
* Fixed Healing mushroom not being harvestable
* Fixed the Mermaid's Singing Rock logic to require a weapon of sort
* Typo in the Motocross section
* Fixed filler items now also giving Lunch Box, Large Lunch Box and Healing Mushroom
* Fixed chest in stormy mountains not respawning if not having grabbed the two wings
* Fix #7 : Manualy trigger the Telescope location upon completing the event as it becomes unpickable once the Look and See!? event is cleared
* Fix: Look and See event was reported accessible without Telescope in the inventory
* Fix #8 : Baron is no longer randomized as it breaks related events
* Changes the location/item association algorithm, location that do not have coordinates are prioritized
* Added regression tests
* Fix #15 
* Fix #13 
* Fix Softlock with the phoenix if phoenix mountain event is cleared
* Fix #17 : Uses The Real Evil Pig event instead of Grandpa's Bracelet which is unreliable due to appearing much later in the cutscene
* Fix #18 : Introducing door manipulation (thanks to bosshunter on Discord) to force Baccus Village accessible once Phoenix Mountain is cleared and starting the Mouse Pig Bag event in order to avoid Softlock
* Fix #14: Verified the item counts and added locations
* Fix entering Hidden Village with Grapple or GrappleJack
* Fix #16 : Pants can now be grabbed and the locations are associated correctly regardless of the current pants Tomba owns
* Fix Flower Seeds not being in logic before forest is cleared
* And probably many other issues I forgot to track

### 🚫 Non-Randomized Elements
To preserve game stability, the following elements remain in their vanilla states and are **not randomized**:
* The **Furious Tornado** on the mailbox.
* The **Frog** required for the *Take Me Home* event.
* **Healing Mushroom** and **Blue Powder** are no longer randomized

---

## 🔧 Installation
1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file.
2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.

v0.2.2-beta.description:
Second **beta release** introducing several new settings and a better location management that should hopefully results in less missing checks

> [!WARNING]
> This release is in testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🛠️ Core Optimization & Stability
* **Overhauled Location Tracking**: Rewrote location metadata to double-check in-game status directly instead of guessing. This drastically reduces missing checks.
* **Performance Boost**: Enhanced overall responsiveness and speed of the new location/check system.

### 🗺️ Logic & Rule Fixes
* **Expanded Item Pool**: Added all remaining chests containing AP Crystals or Apples to the randomized pool.
* **Reachability Fixes**: Corrected rules for accessing locations via item combinations or specific conditions.
* **Key Requirements**: Fixed several item locations that were mistakenly assigned the wrong required key.
* **Jump Rule Update**: Updated the `CAN_BIG_JUMP` rule to correctly include **Psychic Fish** and **Blue Powder**.
* **Missing Items**: Restored the 3 missing 1Ups from the *Million Year Old Chest* in **Familiar Mansion**.
* **Typo Fixes**: Cleaned up minor text errors.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

v0.3.5-beta.description:
Third **beta release** introducing yet again new settings and minor fixes

> [!WARNING]
> This release is in testing phase. While core progression mechanics are fully functional, you may encounter minor bugs or pacing quirks. Please report any logic errors or generation issues on the issue tracker.

---

## ✨ What's New

### 🛠️ Core Optimization & Stability
* **Deathlink**: You can now enable deathlink in Tomba!
* **No Game Over**: If you are tired of Game Over screens, you can opt in for infinite life instead!
* **Random status alteration**: This one allows for random status alteration: Tomba! will sometimes start crying or laughing instead of getting an usefull item

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fix: Can no longer get the location where you are supposed to get Yan's Lunch Box after Go Hide and Seek is cleared: This is now force cleared upon clearing the event
* Fix: The chest in Ol'Pond was wrongly configured, this is now fixed
* Fix: The location where you get the big key upon clearing the Big Painting of a key event is now checked too when Haunted Mansion is purified early
* Fix: Chest in the tree at VOAB with the Bell in it was also wrongly configured and is now fixed

---

## 🔧 Installation
1. Download the source code or the `.apworld` file.
2. Drop it into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` directory.
